state.task: Adaptive traffic-signal control for one intersection. You see three camera frames of the same intersection, in chronological order (oldest first, latest last). The current phase is serving with a fixed 5-second green tail counted down at the end. Decide now: extend the current green by 5 more seconds when traffic still needs it, or switch the green to another phase when the current one is clearing and another direction has waiting traffic.

phases.n1: S approach through, right and left turns (yellow 3s, all-red 9s)
phases.n2: E approach through, right and left turns (yellow 3s, all-red 9s)
phases.n3: W approach through, right and left turns (yellow 3s, all-red 9s)
phases.n4: N approach through, right and left turns (yellow 3s, all-red 9s)

intersection_layout.approaches: Four approaches (E/N/S/W), each with through/right lanes and a left-turn lane (movements served vary by phase).
intersection_layout.camera_view: Tiled 1600x900 frame from 4 cameras, one per approach.
